agent.finish_summary: Added a depth limit to the recurse decorator in sqlparse/utils.py. Deeply nested parentheses now raise SQLParseError 'Maximum grouping depth exceeded (100).' rather than a generic RecursionError message. I checked this by hand with 150 and 1000 nested parentheses. I did not run a test suite: the repo has no tests directory, so pytest collected nothing.
